note: The two sets are nearly identical, sharing 16 claims including the same table values, geometry facts, and figure readings. The only differences are the Young's modulus and shear modulus claims: Set B binds them to 'tower steel' and keeps the Table 4-1 source condition, while Set A gives the vaguer entity 'steel' and drops the condition. Both sets contain the same misread (tower 1st natural frequency 0.18 Hz, contradicting the stated 0.170 Hz) and duplicate that fact under two names/values.
remarks: Both sets report the tower 1st natural frequency twice with inconsistent values (0.18 Hz and 0.17 Hz); the text layer clearly states 0.170 Hz, so 0.18 Hz is a misread and the pair is a duplicate. The 1P (0.09-0.13 Hz) and 3P (0.25-0.38 Hz) ranges and the wave/wind PSD readings are taken from Figure 4-1 and are only approximately verifiable from the plot. Both sets omit the 7% outfitting mass allowance, the 100 t transition piece mass, and the note that a floating substructure requires a stiffer tower.
